name: Conrad Shanghai
insider_take: Towering above the Huangpu River, this architectural marvel puts Shanghai's glittering skyline literally at your fingertips.
whats_special: The Conrad Shanghai occupies floors 39-51 of the iconic IFC Tower, offering some of the highest hotel rooms in the city. The property features floor-to-ceiling windows with unobstructed views of the Bund, Oriental Pearl Tower, and Shanghai World Financial Center. The hotel's signature restaurant, Bao Li Xuan, serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in an elegant setting overlooking the historic waterfront.
pro_tip: Book a Huangpu River view room on floors 45+ for the most spectacular sunrise views over the Bund - the early morning light creates perfect photo opportunities of Shanghai's historic architecture.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct connection to IFC Mall for luxury shopping, plus its prime Lujiazui location puts you steps from the Shanghai World Financial Center Observatory and just a 5-minute walk to the Bund Sightseeing Tunnel. The nearby Century Avenue offers easy metro access to explore French Concession and other districts.
pros: Prime location in Huangpu District with easy access to The Bund and Nanjing Road
Stunning panoramic views of Shanghai skyline and Huangpu River
Exceptional service standards with multilingual staff and personalized attention
Modern luxury amenities including spa, fitness center, and multiple dining venues
cons: Premium pricing reflects luxury positioning in competitive Shanghai market
High-rise urban setting may not suit guests preferring quieter environments
